releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder support Custom weekday recurrence. All previous repeat options for each section, saved entries, snooze timing and limits, ringtone, notifications and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web update 323: In Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder, the Custom weekday picker closes after a weekday is selected, has an × close control, and can be reopened to select additional days. Existing selections and recurrence behavior are preserved.
